description: This file defines an Android RecyclerView adapter and view holder for displaying a horizontally scrollable list of match cards, likely for a sports scoreboard app. It handles rendering match details, loading images, and focus behavior.

classes.name: MatchAdapter
classes.description: An adapter that binds Match data to RecyclerView items, supporting efficient diffing and item updates.

classes.name: MatchViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class that binds individual match data to the UI components and handles click and key events.

methods.name: Diff
methods.description: An object implementing DiffUtil.ItemCallback for efficient list updates.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a MatchViewHolder, inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for the given position.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds Match data to the ViewHolder's UI elements.
